purpose_context: Spec Kitty's skills tell agents to pass --mission to every command, but five migrate subcommands that mutate corpus/repo-wide content silently accept and ignore it (exit 0), so an agent gets an unscoped rewrite from a flag it was told to pass. This mission makes those commands reject --mission with a clear not-mission-scoped error.
purpose_tldr: Non-mission-scoped migrate commands reject --mission loudly instead of silently ignoring it.
contracts_rationale: CLI parse-layer refusal: no interfaces, endpoints, or data entities. The mission makes five migrate subcommands reject --mission; there is no contract surface to document.
